scripts.build: npm run build:mcp && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:mcp: vite build --config vite.mcp.config.ts && vite build --config vite.mcp-adapter.config.ts
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:bridge: npm run build:mcp && node scripts/check-mcp.mjs && node scripts/check-session.mjs && node scripts/check-project-dialogs.mjs && node scripts/check-mcp-configuration.mjs
